```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    //@ requires digits != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   digits.length == 0
    //@   || (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < digits.length / 2;
    //@       ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)))
    //@     && (
    //@       (digits.length % 2 == 1) ==> 
    //@         (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 
    //@         || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 
    //@         || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
    //@     )
    //@   )
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@   ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0)
        //@   || (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1)
        //@   || (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8)
        //@   || (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9)
        //@   || (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases (len / 2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IsStrictlyDecreasing {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (arr.length < 2 || (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length - 1; arr[i] > arr[i + 1]));
    public static boolean IsStrictlyDecreasing(int[] arr) {
        int n = arr.length;
        if (n < 2) {
            return true;
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n - 1;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] > arr[j + 1];
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (arr[i] <= arr[i + 1])
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {

        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;

            i = i + 1;

    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
```

```
    //@      )
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@   ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))
        //@ );
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases len / 2 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
    public static boolean IsStrictlyDecreasing(int[] arr) {
        int n = arr.length;
        if (n < 2) {
            return true;
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; arr[j] > arr[j + 1];
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
```

```
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

```
```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ ensures (operator == '%') ==> \result == num1 % num2;
    //@ ensures (operator != '+' && operator != '-' && operator != '*' && operator != '/' && operator != '%') ==> \result == -1;
    public static int calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        int output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = num1 * num2;
            break;

            output = num1 / num2;

            output = num1 % num2;
```

```
    public static int romanNumeralToDec(char N) {
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

assistant: ```
public class TwoSum {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ requires \exists int i, j; 0 <= i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] == target;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result.length == 2;
    //@ ensures 0 <= \result[0] && \result[0] < \result[1] && \result[1] < nums.length;
    //@ ensures nums[\result[0]] + nums[\result[1]] == target;
    //@ also
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ requires \forall int i, j; 0 <= i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] != target;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result.length == 0;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int a, b; 0 <= a < i && a < b < n; nums[a] + nums[b] != target;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i < n;
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining \forall int a; i < a < j; nums[i] + nums[a] != target;
            //@ loop_writes j;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {

                inc = false;

            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Min {
    public static int min(int[] a) {
        int res = a[0];

        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            res = ((a[i] < res) ? a[i] : res);
        }
```

```
public class CompareArray {
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (
    //@      (a == null && b == null) ||
    //@      (a != null && b != null &&
    //@       a.length == b.length &&
    //@       (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; a[i] == b[i]))
    //@  );
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
```

        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x, y; 1 <= x < i && 1 <= y < m; mat[x][y] == mat[x-1][y-1]);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 - 1 <= j <= m;  
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 1 <= y < j; mat[i][y] == mat[i-1][y-1]);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ ensures (a.length == 0) ==> (\result == -1);
    //@ ensures (a.length > 0) ==> (0 <= \result && \result < a.length);
    //@ ensures (a.length > 0) ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[\result] >= a[i]);
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= biggest < a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < index; a[biggest] >= a[k];
        //@ loop_writes index, biggest;
        //@ decreases a.length - index;
        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
    //@         (arr != null && \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
    //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@          )
    //@         );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
        //@ );
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];

                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;

                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];

        int right1  = rec1[2];
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \everything;
    //@  ensures \result != null;
    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i];
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i];
    //@ also
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < m; ret[k] == a[k];
        //@ maintaining \forall int l; i + m <= l < m + n; ret[l] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index <= x.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < index; x[j] == y[x.length - 1 - j];
        //@ loop_writes index;
        //@ decreases x.length - index;
        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@          ));
```


and

```
    //@ requires (operator != '/' && operator != '%') || num2 != 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures operator == '+' ==> \result == (long)num1 + num2;
    //@ ensures operator == '-' ==> \result == (long)num1 - num2;
    //@ ensures operator == '*' ==> \result == (long)num1 * num2;
    //@ ensures operator == '/' ==> \result == (long)num1 / num2;
    //@ ensures operator == '%' ==> \result == (long)num1 % num2;
    //@ ensures !(operator == '+' || operator == '-' || operator == '*' || operator == '/' || operator == '%') ==> \result == -1;
    public static long calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

            output = (long)num1 * num2;

            output = (long)num1 / num2;
            break;

            output = (long)num1 % num2;
```

```
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```

```
    //@ ensures (operator == '/') ==> \result == num1 / num2;
    //@ ensures (operator == '%') ==> \result == num1 % num2;
    //@ ensures (operator != '+' && operator != '-' && operator != '*' && operator != '/' && operator != '%') ==> \result == -1;
    public static int calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        int output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = num1 - num2;
            break;

            break;
```

```
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i];
    //@ also
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m; ret[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j];
 
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
    //@          )
    //@         );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
```
        //@ maintaining wordStart == (\forall int k; 0 < k <= i;   
        //@     Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ? true : 
        //@     (k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) ? false : true);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;

        //@ );

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ requires mat != null;

    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length - 1; mat[i].length == mat[i+1].length);
```

```
        if (x.length != y.length)

        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {

            return false;
```

```
        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

            ret[i] = a[i];

        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i];
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i];
    //@ also

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        return ret;

}
```

```
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
```
```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
```
```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {

            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

assistant: ```
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
    //@         (arr != null && \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; 
    //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@          )
    //@         );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@               (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@               (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@               (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
        //@              );
        //@ loop_invariant wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[0..n-1], i, wordStart;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];

        int right1  = rec1[2];
```

```
public class IsPowerOfTwo {
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return false;

        while (n > 1) {
```

```
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ ensures (a.length == 0 && \result == -1) || 
    //@         (0 <= \result && \result < a.length && 
    //@          \forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] <= a[\result]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= biggest < a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int i; 0 <= i < index; a[i] <= a[biggest];
        //@ loop_writes index, biggest;
        //@ decreases a.length - index;
        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

+ You SHOULD generate `ensures` statements for every method, and `maintaining` statements for every loop.

assistant: ```
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
    //@         (arr != null && \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; 
    //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && !(i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@          )
    //@         );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
        //@    (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) &&
        //@    (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && (k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) ==> ret[k] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[k])) &&
        //@    (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) && !(k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) ==> ret[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k]))
        //@ );
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
```

```
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x; 0 <= x < i; 
        //@               \forall int y; 0 <= y < n; ret[x][y] == A[m - 1 - x][n - 1 - y]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*][*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < j; ret[i][y] == A[m - 1 - i][n - 1 - y]);
            //@ loop_writes ret[i][*], j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
```

```
public class IsPalindrome {
    public static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int n = s.length();

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(n - 1 - i)) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;

}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
    //@         (arr != null && \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; 
    //@             (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@             (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@             (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@          ));
    //@ pure
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; 
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
        //@ );
        //@ loop_invariant wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
        //@ loop_writes i, wordStart, ret[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result != null;
    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i];
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i];
    //@ also
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < m; ret[k] == a[k];
```

```
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```
